description: NL2SQL 执行准确率评测案例（生产量级：分类×难度系统覆盖；golden 与 LLM 同一只读连接执行，结果集等价判定）

cases.question: 目前一共有多少个未关闭且未验证的问题单？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues WHERE status NOT IN ('closed', 'verified')

cases.question: 业务线 ev 的严重级别为 critical 的问题有多少个？

cases.question: critical 级别且未关闭的问题单有多少个？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues WHERE severity = 'critical' AND status NOT IN ('closed','verified')

cases.question: 按软件版本统计问题单数量。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT sw_version, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues GROUP BY sw_version

cases.question: 按业务线统计 verified 问题数量。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT business_line, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues WHERE status = 'verified' GROUP BY business_line

cases.question: 各来源的 blocker 问题数量。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues WHERE severity = 'blocker' GROUP BY source

cases.question: 配置项按供应商统计数量（前 5）。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT supplier, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_config_items GROUP BY supplier ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 各基线状态（冻结/未冻结）的变更请求数。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT b.is_frozen, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_change_requests cr JOIN alm_baselines b ON cr.target_baseline_id = b.id GROUP BY b.is_frozen

cases.question: 按车型统计有 DTC 快照的问题单数量。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT model_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues WHERE dtc_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND dtc_snapshot <> '' GROUP BY model_code

cases.question: 按责任域统计 confirmed 之外的问题（status<>'closed'）数量。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT od.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues ai JOIN owner_domains od ON ai.owner_domain_id = od.id WHERE ai.status <> 'closed' GROUP BY od.name ORDER BY cnt DESC

cases.question: 需求按业务线统计数量。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT business_line, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_requirements GROUP BY business_line

cases.question: 各状态的 ev 业务线问题数量。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues WHERE business_line = 'ev' GROUP BY status

cases.question: 哪个业务线的 critical 最多？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT business_line, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues WHERE severity = 'critical' GROUP BY business_line ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 哪个车型有 DTC 快照的问题最多？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT model_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues WHERE dtc_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND dtc_snapshot <> '' GROUP BY model_code ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 最新的一条需求编号和创建时间。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT req_no, created_at FROM alm_requirements ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: P1 优先级需求最多的状态是什么？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_requirements WHERE priority = 'P1' GROUP BY status ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 每个来源的 blocker 数量排名前 2。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues WHERE severity = 'blocker' GROUP BY source ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 2

cases.question: 哪些配置项类别超过 50 个？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_config_items GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 ORDER BY cnt DESC

cases.question: 2026 年 3 月到 5 月按月统计问题单量（YYYY-MM）。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', created_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-01' AND created_at < '2026-06-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', created_at) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', created_at)

cases.question: 2026 年 7 月的变更请求数量。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_change_requests WHERE created_at >= '2026-07-01' AND created_at < '2026-08-01'

cases.question: 最近 90 天各严重级别的问题数量。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT severity, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY severity

cases.question: 2026 年 4 月到 6 月按月统计变更请求量（YYYY-MM）。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', created_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_change_requests WHERE created_at >= '2026-04-01' AND created_at < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', created_at) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', created_at)

cases.question: 2026 年 8 月创建的需求有多少个？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_requirements WHERE created_at >= '2026-08-01' AND created_at < '2026-09-01'

cases.question: 最近 30 天 ev 业务线创建了多少问题单？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND business_line = 'ev'

cases.question: 电驱系统域的 open 问题有多少个？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues ai JOIN owner_domains od ON ai.owner_domain_id = od.id WHERE od.name = '电驱系统域' AND ai.status = 'open'

cases.question: 各责任域 blocker 问题里有多少带 DTC 快照？输出域名和数量。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT od.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues ai JOIN owner_domains od ON ai.owner_domain_id = od.id WHERE ai.severity = 'blocker' AND ai.dtc_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND ai.dtc_snapshot <> '' GROUP BY od.name ORDER BY cnt DESC

cases.question: 未冻结基线被多少变更请求指向？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_change_requests cr JOIN alm_baselines b ON cr.target_baseline_id = b.id WHERE b.is_frozen = false

cases.question: 智能座舱域各状态的问题单数量。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT ai.status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues ai JOIN owner_domains od ON ai.owner_domain_id = od.id WHERE od.name = '智能座舱域' GROUP BY ai.status

cases.question: 需求挂在已冻结基线上的有多少个？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_requirements r JOIN alm_baselines b ON r.baseline_id = b.id WHERE b.is_frozen = true

cases.question: 各业务线在已冻结基线上的需求数量。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT r.business_line, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_requirements r JOIN alm_baselines b ON r.baseline_id = b.id WHERE b.is_frozen = true GROUP BY r.business_line ORDER BY cnt DESC

cases.question: 变更请求及其目标基线（只列 reviewing 状态，前 10 条）。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT cr.cr_no, b.name FROM alm_change_requests cr JOIN alm_baselines b ON cr.target_baseline_id = b.id WHERE cr.status = 'reviewing' LIMIT 10

cases.question: 列出 verified 状态问题的单号。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT issue_no FROM alm_issues WHERE status = 'verified'

cases.question: 车型 EV-B01 的 critical 问题标题。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT title FROM alm_issues WHERE model_code = 'EV-B01' AND severity = 'critical'

cases.question: business 来源的问题单号和状态。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT issue_no, status FROM alm_issues WHERE source = 'business'

cases.question: 列出问题单号、标题、责任域名称（按创建时间倒序前 15 条）。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT ai.issue_no, ai.title, od.name FROM alm_issues ai JOIN owner_domains od ON ai.owner_domain_id = od.id ORDER BY ai.created_at DESC LIMIT 15

cases.question: 列出所有需求的状态种类。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM alm_requirements

cases.question: customer 来源且未关闭的问题单号和标题。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT issue_no, title FROM alm_issues WHERE source = 'customer' AND status NOT IN ('closed','verified')

cases.question: 有外部引用编号（external_ref 非空）的问题单里，按来源统计数量。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues WHERE external_ref IS NOT NULL AND external_ref <> '' GROUP BY source ORDER BY cnt DESC

cases.question: 有 DTC 快照且状态为 analyzing 的问题单数量。
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues WHERE dtc_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND dtc_snapshot <> '' AND status = 'analyzing'
